answer: Make grading influence non-transferable and earned through blind review: each agent scores work from randomly drawn strangers, and its own pay depends on matching the eventual consensus. A sybil farm is like karst, riddled with hidden channels; its clones trade inflated scores, which shows up as correlated outliers that get zeroed. Honest reputation builds like shale, one thin layer per epoch, until a long clean record is as rare as opal.
